subject: general
question: Which of the following is responsible for dwarfism in humans?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pituitary.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The pituitary is responsible for dwarfism in humans.**
 
• Growth hormone is released into the bloodstream from the anterior pituitary gland.
 
• The pituitary gland also produces other hormones that have different functions from growth hormones.
 
• Growth hormone is produced by the pituitary gland.
 
 
• It has many functions including maintaining normal body structure and metabolism.
 
• It is a small pea-sized gland that plays a major role in regulating vital body functions.
 
• It is also referred to as the 'master gland' of the human body as it controls the activity of most of the other hormone-secreting glands.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thyroxine** is the main hormone secreted into the bloodstream by the thyroid gland. 

 
 
• It is also called tetraiodothyronine. It maintains the basic metabolism of the body.
 
 
 
• **Adrenaline hormone** is secreted by the adrenal gland.
 
 
• Adrenaline hormones are rapidly secreted in response to the stress of any kind and during emergency situations and are called emergency hormones or hormones of Fight or Flight.
 
 
 
• **The pancreas** functions as both endocrine and exocrine functions.
 
 
• The pancreas has exocrine glands that produce enzymes that are useful for digestion.
 
• These are released from the acinar cells that act as exocrine cells.
